headline: Drafting and Planning Services Preparation Checklist — La Canada
articleBody:
Drafting and Planning Services Preparation Checklist for La Canada Clients

Before your Drafting and Planning Services appointment with Opus Builders, make sure you have the following ready:

1. Measurements
2. Budget
3. Design preferences
4. Permits needed
5. Material selections

Contact Opus Builders at (818) 939-8855 to get started.
